explain.say: How can a flat piece of paper show a mountain? Imagine slicing a hill like a loaf of bread, one slice every 100 metres up, and drawing round each slice. Look at the board. Those slices are contour lines.

faq.a: A contour line is a line on a map that joins places at the same height above sea level. The lines are drawn at equal steps, such as every 10 metres.
asks: What do the brown lines on a map mean?

faq.q: What does it mean when contour lines are close together?
faq.a: Close lines mean the height changes quickly over a short distance, so the slope is steep. Far-apart lines mean a gentle slope or flat land.
asks: How do contour lines show a steep slope?

faq.q: How do I find a hilltop on a map?
faq.a: Look for the smallest closed ring of contour lines, with the biggest numbers inside. A dot with a height number, called a spot height, often marks the very top.

faq.q: Why are heights measured from sea level?
faq.a: The sea gives the whole world one shared starting line, so heights in different countries can be compared. Mount Everest is 8,849 metres above sea level.
asks: What does above sea level mean?

faq.a: The contour interval is the height difference between one contour line and the next, such as 10 metres. It is printed on the map, often near the key.
asks: How far apart in height are contour lines?

facts: Kilimanjaro in Tanzania, Africa's highest mountain, rises 5,895 m above sea level.
In 2020 China and Nepal announced a new height for Mount Everest: 8,848.86 m.

quiz.say: On a map, contour lines are squeezed very close together. What is the land like there?
quiz.show: Contour lines squeezed close together mean the land is…
quiz.why: Close contour lines mean the height changes fast over a short distance: a steep slope.

wrong.1: Flat land has contour lines far apart, or none at all.
wrong.2: Contour lines on land show height above sea level, not water.

quiz.say: What does a contour line join together?
quiz.why: Every point on a contour line is at the same height above sea level.

wrong.1: Contour lines are about height, not names.
wrong.2: Roads have their own symbols; contours show height.
